title: Open incidents on production servers
description: Return unresolved incidents only for production servers. Return exactly four columns: incident_id, hostname, severity, opened_seq. Sort by opened_seq ASC, then incident_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT i.id AS incident_id, s.hostname, i.severity, i.opened_seq
FROM incidents AS i
hints: environment is stored in servers while resolved is stored in incidents.
solution_explanation: A join is required because the environment filter and incident data live in different tables.
